Round 29 passes for everything I could reach in the real Studio, and I found no new bugs. Two of B's checks (R29-NE and the 40ΓÇô41 no-op window) were not run: the real UI can't create the range they need. I've marked those "not run", not PASS.

**What passed in the browser** (`/studio-lab`, 1440├ù900; footer also at 1280├ù720):
- **All-lane Cut (R29-PA):** I cut 20ΓÇô22 from music with all lanes selected, made SFX the active lane, and pasted at 20. The part went back to music at 20 (offset 13, length 2), the label was `ßâ⌐ßâÉßâíßâ¢ßâÉ (1)`, and the status didn't name SFX. An export before the cut and one after the paste match exactly in the 20ΓÇô22 s window (0 LSB difference).
- **All-lane Copy (R29-PB):** the same with Ctrl+C, pasted at 26 ΓåÆ on music.
- **Cut Time (R29-PC):** the material from 14ΓÇô16 pasted back on music at 30. The later clip moved left by 2.000 s, the loop went from 12ΓÇô18 to 12ΓÇô16, and the stopped playhead went from 26 to 24. Undo and Redo restore and replay each step exactly.
- **Single-lane paste unchanged (R29-PD):** a single-lane range and a single clip still paste onto the active SFX lane. A Cut Time across video and SFX pastes back onto both original lanes.
- **Cut Time with nothing to cut (R29-NO, zero-width):** nothing changes: no history entry, the playhead stays at 20, the range and clip selection stay, the status is honest, and the next paste uses the previous clipboard. While playing there is no jump, stop or restart.
- **Footer (R29-FT):** `ßâºßâòßâößâÜßâÉ ßâ«ßâÉßâûßâÿ` appears only after Ctrl+Shift+L. The line doesn't wrap at 1440 or 1280, and every height matches round 28. A couldn't check this; I did.
- **Nearby behaviour:**
  - Delete over all lanes still leaves the gap.
  - Ctrl+L still toggles the loop.
  - Ctrl+Shift+Delete does nothing.
  - Paste and Cut Time are refused during a clip drag.
  - Overlap and empty-clipboard pastes are refused.
  - Ctrl+Shift+X with no range gives the right message.
  - The meters move during playback.
- **Premium access is not bypassed (G29-3):** in a fresh browser with no login, the demo page opens. The token endpoint returns 401 without login, and a fake login token gets no token back. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required". No request from the session carried an `Authorization` header.

**Offline checks:**
- **Tests and build:** type check clean; 1133/1133 tests pass, including A's 14 new ones; the build succeeds; lint has 0 errors.
- **Files:** `store/` was the same at the start and end of my session: 67 changed files (A's 66 plus the new test file), all 72 frozen files and the 4 protected files unchanged.
- **Test strength:** in a scratch copy outside `store/`, each of the seven code-breaking changes B asked for (aΓÇôg, with g tried two ways) makes at least one test fail. A's "8 tests fail on the old code" claim also checks out.
- **C-R27-02:** closed under B's rule: three runs of the 8-file test batch, all green, with 10 `node.exe` processes running (under the 30 limit).

**For B:**
- **Unreachable cases:** a selected range always stays inside a clip, and Undo, moving a clip or Delete clears it. So a window with no material inside can't be made from the UI, which means R29-NE and the 40ΓÇô41 case are covered only by A's tests. Doc 034 describes these cases without saying they can't happen in practice.
- **Escape:** neither Escape nor clicking a lane name clears a range. Because of that, one of my Ctrl+Shift+X presses cut 10ΓÇô12 by accident. It behaved correctly and Undo restored it, so I didn't file a bug.
- **Still open, outside this round:** C-R27-01 (waiting on the Tech Lead's quiet-Chrome measurement), C-R23-01 (2 NUL bytes at 28013/28014, unchanged), and the root items. All are carried in the report.

**Problems on my side:**
- **Dev server down:** it was down when I started (16:51); root brought it back at 17:08, and every browser check ran after that.
- **Scratch-copy failure:** my first scratch-copy test run had no `node_modules`, so `npx` downloaded `vitest@5.0.4` into the npm cache. `store/` wasn't touched, and I re-ran correctly through a temporary link to `store/node_modules`, now removed.
- **One invalid step:** one Delete step used a range outside the clip, so I discarded it and repeated it correctly.
- **No final review:** the advisor model was overloaded, so the final report didn't get its review.

I made no app edits and no commits. Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`: the report is `c-round-29.md`, B's machine-readable summary is `c-round-29.json`, and the evidence is in `c-round-29/`.
